tasks.label: NovelVerse backend (local)
args: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/health >/dev/null; then echo Backend already healthy on port 8080; exit 0; fi; if ss -ltnH sport = :8080 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then echo Port 8080 is occupied but backend health failed; inspect the existing process before starting another backend >&2; exit 1; fi; export DB_URL="jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/$POSTGRES_DB"; export DB_USER="$POSTGRES_USER"; export DB_PASSWORD="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD"; export JWT_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 64); export IP_HASH_SALT=$(openssl rand -hex 32); export APP_WEB_ORIGIN="http://localhost:3000"; cd backend; exec env JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Dnet.bytebuddy.experimental=true ./mvnw spring-boot:run
